description: FastAPI router module for handling employee attendance clock-in/out and session listing, including database interactions and audit logging.

methods.name: _require_employee
methods.description: Ensures the principal has an associated employee ID, raises HTTP 400 if not.

methods.name: clock_in
methods.description: Handles clock-in requests, creates or updates attendance session, and logs audit.

methods.name: clock_out
methods.description: Handles clock-out requests, updates attendance session with clock-out time and minutes worked, and logs audit.

methods.name: list_sessions
methods.description: Lists attendance sessions for an organization within a date range, with optional employee filtering.
